interpretation.mechanism: Target offset is FK(previous command)-FK(measured qpos); common WORLD translation cancels in comparing targets. Command FK increment is not necessarily nominal increment (IK residual). Orientation right-multiplies local exponential, with source has_rot threshold applied.
interpretation.persistence: Use signed base residuals and endpoint sum of command-minus-measured increments, not sum of base residuals: repeated offsets are not independent accumulated drift. Observational quantification is not a causal counterfactual rollout.
interpretation.training: Previously verified labels encode measured EEF increments, not command FK increments. Here compare recorded deployment increments only; training command-increment distribution UNKNOWN.
